title: HIDI Seminar Series launch: explainable AI for Earth observation
description: Dr Tej Bahadur Shahi introduces HIDI's flagship research theme: from real-time satellite monitoring of grassland and vegetation health to interpretable models and a foundational GeoAI model for Nepal's SDGs. Free to attend.

title: Seminar: Nepali and code-mixed text, from POS tagging to NepEMO
description: A decade of Nepali NLP research, the NepEMO emotion dataset, and open problems for low-resource and code-mixed languages. Free to attend.

title: Python for Research and Data Science: first cohort
description: Four to six weeks of live sessions, practical assignments using real Nepali datasets, and a final mini-project. 10–15 places.

title: Hands-on workshop: drones and machine learning for crop monitoring
description: From flight planning and multispectral imagery to vegetation indices and deep-learning models for disease and weed detection. For students, researchers and agricultural professionals.

title: HIDI Annual Workshop on Data Intelligence
description: Tutorials, keynote talks, and student paper and poster sessions on explainable GeoAI, drones for agriculture, multi-modal data intelligence and low-resource NLP.
